newsitem.title: CHINA: HK people protest over Japan's invasion of China.
newsitem.headline: HK people protest over Japan's invasion of China.

text.p: Hong Kong activists protested near the Japanese consulate on Sunday over Japan's invasion of China which began 60 years ago and lasted until the end of World War Two.

Protestors demanded Japan apologise for the invasion and offer compensation to war victims. They also urged China defend its sovereignty over an island chain in the East China Sea, known as the Diaoyus to Chinese or Senkakus to Japanese, and which is also claimed by Japan and Taiwan.
Hong Kong was occupied by Japan from 1941 to 1945.
Many elderly Hong Kong people, including those who immigrated to the territory after the war, can recall atrocities committed by Japanese forces.
